item.title: NVIDIA Built a 'Catching-You-Red-Handed' Sandbox for AI Agents in Rust: Inside OpenShell
item.description: NVIDIA's open-source agent runtime OpenShell: 28 Rust crates, Landlock + seccomp + SMT formal verification to stop agents from stepping out of line. I compiled and ran the full CLI + gateway on a 2-core box, default policy auto-applied, escalation sequence re-run, single exec wall 278ms. Numbers at the end.
